rationale: Bus_2 is under-voltage at 0.925 pu vs min 0.95 pu. Needed rise = 0.025 pu; sensitivity is 0.006 pu/Mvar, so minimum reactive support = 0.025/0.006 = 4.1667 Mvar. Applied 4.17 Mvar (within [0, 20]) to cover the violation with a small numerical margin, yielding final bus_2 voltage 0.925 + 0.006*4.17 = 0.95002 pu, inside [0.95, 1.05]. Cost = 4.17 * 1.0 = 4.17.
